verdict.rationale: OpenCode's GitHub integration docs explicitly describe asking it to fix an issue or implement a feature, after which it creates a new branch and submits a PR with the changes — a direct end-to-end issue-to-PR workflow. However, this claim is first-party only; the community evidence discusses harness quality, tool-call reliability, and bugs in general sessions but never specifically corroborates or tests the GitHub issue→PR automation. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the GitHub issue-to-PR flow specifically, details on how it selects/reads the tracked issue, and evidence of reliability at scale.
